title: Built-in email import and Herd reply testing
summary: Administrators manage the reply mailbox password from Keys and secrets, see a built-in read-only connection on Admin → Emails → Import, and can fetch mail, watch import health and retry held or failed messages. Local developers can test the full replies-by-email loop through Laravel Herd's mail catcher.
changes: The reply mailbox connection is built in: host, port, encryption, username and folders come from the app and the server environment. Administrators no longer type those values on the Import page.

Admin → Settings → Keys and secrets is the only place to set or clear the mailbox password. Saving or clearing it asks for a fresh sign-in check, never shows the value again, and records the change in the audit log. Environment and Vault values still win over a saved secret.

Admin → Emails → Import shows a read-only connection panel with where each value comes from, a Fetch now control with a safe round-trip probe, an import monitor (health, counts, chart and recent imports), and a held and failed queue with retry and a menu badge.

On Laravel Herd locally, inbound mail can be polled from Herd's mail catcher, a "Reply as client" action posts a test reply into that catcher, and tickets:inbound-loop-check confirms the loop is ready. Continuous integration can run an optional GreenMail IMAPS job when the image is available.
The mail and Herd guides, wiki pages and agent instructions describe the built-in connection, Keys and secrets, Import monitor and local Herd reply testing.
version_rationale: Patch: built-in connection and admin Import improvements on top of v0.63.0 email import, plus local Herd reply testing. No breaking route or database change for existing installs.
validation: Feature tests cover SecretRegistry password resolution, Keys and secrets write-only save and clear with step-up, retirement of the Import connection form, the read-only connection panel, Fetch now and probe, the import monitor, the held and failed queue with retry, the Herd inbound driver and reply-as-client flow, inbound-loop-check, and the optional GreenMail IMAPS job (skipped when the extension or image is missing).
Pint on changed files, the translation key check and the release-history validate against origin/main passed; composer pre-pr-verify ran before the pull request was marked ready.
known_limitations: Replies by email on the live app still need the Cloudron mailbox owner, its Mail Client app password and the reply token key set up after the deploy (issue #754).
Herd inbound polling and Reply as client are for local development only; production continues to use the built-in IMAP connection.
rollback: Deploy v0.63.1 with deploy-cloudron.yml. Mailbox password values saved under Keys and secrets remain in the secrets store and are ignored by v0.63.1; clear them there if rolling back before a re-deploy of this release.
provenance: Milestone v0.63.2 Beta: Built-in email import and Herd reply testing, epic #807 with issues #808, #809, #810, #811, #812, #813, #814, #815, #816, #817, #818, #819 and #820; pull request #822. Ops hand-off #754 stays open until after deploy.
